roadmap.title: Normal story playthrough and in-chapter missables
roadmap.description: Clear the Prologue through Chapter 10 up to the final boss and collect every story-bound missable along the way: Fort Tamblin, Banora, the Midgar minigames, the Wutai spies, fan clubs, flower wagon parts, Nibelheim's Seven Wonders, sniping, the Gongaga waterfall, and the Cage of Binding. Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter.

roadmap.title: Pre-final-boss cleanup
roadmap.description: From the save point before the final boss, reach 100% DMW progress and 100% mission completion, unlock the remaining shops and mail senders, collect all Genji equipment, deal 99,999 damage, and defeat Minerva in Mission 9-6-6.

roadmap.title: Hard final boss
roadmap.description: Set the difficulty to Hard and defeat the final boss to clear Chapter 10 and unlock the Hard-mode completion achievement.

roadmap.title: Platinum
roadmap.description: The completion achievement appears once every other achievement is earned.

achievements.description: Unlocked all achievements.
achievements.sortReason: Capstone achievement; resolves when the Hard clear and every collection are complete.
achievements.summary: Earn all 50 other achievements.

guide.context: No DLC is required; the list is entirely offline and reaches completion on a single save file.

steps.text: Obtain every other achievement on this list; the completion award appears together with the last one.

achievements.description: Clear the Prologue.
achievements.sortReason: Mandatory Prologue progress.
achievements.summary: Clear the Prologue of the main story.

steps.text: Play the opening mission and finish it; the achievement appears on the chapter results screen.

achievements.description: Clear Chapter 1.
achievements.sortReason: Mandatory Chapter 1 progress.
achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 1 of the main story.

steps.text: Complete the @loc{Fort Tamblin} assault and continue until the Chapter 1 results screen appears.

achievements.description: Clear Chapter 2.
achievements.sortReason: Mandatory Chapter 2 progress.
achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 2 of the main story.

steps.text: Clear the @loc{Banora Village} and @loc{Banora Factory} sections and reach the Chapter 2 results screen.

achievements.description: Clear Chapter 3.
achievements.sortReason: Mandatory Chapter 3 progress.
achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 3 of the main story.

steps.text: Clear the Shinra Building assault and the @loc{Mako Reactor 5} section, then reach the Chapter 3 results screen.

achievements.description: Clear Chapter 4.
achievements.sortReason: Mandatory Chapter 4 progress.
achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 4 of the main story.

steps.text: Clear the @loc{Sector 5 Slums} and @loc{Fusion Chamber} sections and reach the Chapter 4 results screen.

achievements.description: Clear Chapter 5.
achievements.sortReason: Mandatory Chapter 5 progress.
achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 5 of the main story.

steps.text: Clear the @loc{Modeo Ravine} and @loc{Modeoheim} sections and reach the Chapter 5 results screen.

achievements.description: Clear Chapter 6.
achievements.sortReason: Mandatory Chapter 6 progress.
achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 6 of the main story.

steps.text: Clear the assault on @loc{Junon} and reach the Chapter 6 results screen.

achievements.description: Clear Chapter 7.
achievements.sortReason: Mandatory Chapter 7 progress.
achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 7 of the main story.

steps.text: Clear the Midgar sections and finish the flower wagon story, then reach the Chapter 7 results screen.

achievements.description: Clear Chapter 8.
achievements.sortReason: Mandatory Chapter 8 progress.
achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 8 of the main story.

steps.text: Clear the @loc{Nibelheim} and @loc{Mt. Nibel} sections and reach the Chapter 8 results screen.

achievements.description: Clear Chapter 9.
achievements.sortReason: Mandatory Chapter 9 progress.
achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 9 of the main story.

steps.text: Clear the Nibelheim aftermath and the @loc{Gongaga} sections and reach the Chapter 9 results screen.

achievements.description: Clear Chapter 10.
achievements.sortReason: Awarded on clearing the final chapter.
achievements.summary: Clear Chapter 10 and finish the story.

steps.text: Clear the final chapter and defeat the last boss; the achievement appears as the story ends.

achievements.description: Won a battle for the first time.
achievements.sortReason: Unlocks with the first fight.
achievements.summary: Win a battle for the first time.

steps.text: Defeat the first group of enemies that appears after the opening cutscene.

achievements.description: Performed a limit break for the first time.
achievements.sortReason: Unlocks automatically once the DMW rolls a limit break.
achievements.summary: Trigger a limit break during an early battle.

guide.context: A limit break fires when the DMW reels land on three matching images during battle.

steps.text: Keep fighting until the reels line up three matching images; the limit break triggers on its own.

achievements.description: Performed materia fusion for the first time.
achievements.sortReason: Automatic once Materia Fusion unlocks.
achievements.summary: Perform materia fusion for the first time.

guide.context: Materia Fusion unlocks automatically in Chapter 3 after the Director's Office scene.

steps.text: Open the Materia menu, pick @mechanic{Materia Fusion}, then merge any pair of materia.

achievements.description: Dealt 99,999 damage to an enemy.
achievements.sortReason: Needs the damage cap lifted plus Costly Punch, both from later missions.
achievements.summary: Deal 99,999 damage to an enemy in a single hit.

guide.context: The 9,999 damage cap has to come off first, then one high-power materia must land a single hit for 99,999.

steps.text: Enter @mechanic{Buster Sword stance} and defeat enemies there with @item{Darkness} materia to build stance proficiency; a screen notice confirms the damage limit is lifted.
steps.note: Alternative: equip the @item{Brutal} accessory, which drops from Mission 7-4-6 and Mission 9-5-1 and also sits in a chest during Mission 9-6-3.

steps.text: Fuse @item{Costly Punch} from @item{Goblin Punch} plus any purple materia sold at @loc{Research Dept. QMC+}, or open the chest in Mission 9-5-4 for a ready-made one.
steps.note: Goblin Punch is the reward for collecting 10 chests in the Gongaga waterfall minigame.

steps.text: Hit an enemy with @item{Costly Punch}; its damage grows with Zack's HP, so raise HP before the attempt.

achievements.description: Obtained all DMW images.
achievements.sortReason: Collects story images and mission-reward images, including the missable Phoenix.
achievements.summary: Obtain every DMW image.

guide.context: Most images arrive from story events or mission rewards, but Phoenix is permanently missable if the Nibelheim Seven Wonders quest is skipped.

collectibles.name: Tseng — Air Strike
collectibles.method: Received automatically at the start of Chapter 2.

collectibles.name: Cissnei — Lucky Stars
collectibles.method: Appears automatically once Zack meets Cissnei mid-assault.

collectibles.name: Aerith — Healing Wave
collectibles.method: Received automatically at the start of Chapter 4.

collectibles.name: Cloud — Meteor Shots
collectibles.method: Received automatically while progressing through Modeo Ravine.

collectibles.name: Genesis — Apocalypse
collectibles.method: Received automatically after the Genesis fight.

collectibles.name: Phoenix — Rebirth Flame
collectibles.method: Start the Seven Wonders quest and interact with the water tower.

collectibles.name: Cactuar — 1,000 Needles
collectibles.method: In Mission 3-1-3, beat the Kactuar to open the 10-1 missions, then clear Mission 10-1-3.

collectibles.name: Tonberry — Murderous Thrust
collectibles.method: In Mission 6-1-5, defeat the Tonberry to open the 10-2 missions, then clear Mission 10-2-3.

collectibles.name: Magic Pot — Item Mugger
collectibles.method: During Mission 10-2-3, meet the Magic Pot and perform @item{Jump}, @item{Fira}, @item{Gravity}, and @item{Assault Twister} in the order it requests.

achievements.description: Achieved 100% progress for all DMW.
achievements.sortReason: Luck-based 100% DMW progress; best done as an idle farm.
achievements.summary: Reach 100% progress on every DMW.

guide.context: Only a first-time image raises progress, so repeated scenes do nothing. The reward for 100% is the @item{Genji Armor}, the key piece of the Genji set.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Faerie Ring}, start Mission 1-1-1, and let the DMW reels spin; the constant healing outpaces the enemy damage so Zack survives unattended.
Leave the game running for a few hours, including idle or overnight, until every DMW reads 100%.

achievements.description: Completed 25% of all missions.
achievements.sortReason: Mission completion milestone.
achievements.summary: Complete 75 of the 300 missions.

guide.context: Missions are launched from any save point and the achievement unlocks as the count passes the threshold.

steps.text: Complete any 75 missions from a save point.

achievements.description: Completed 50% of all missions.
achievements.sortReason: Mission completion milestone.
achievements.summary: Complete 150 of the 300 missions.

steps.text: Keep clearing missions from any save point until 150 are finished.

achievements.description: Completed 75% of all missions.
achievements.sortReason: Mission completion milestone.
achievements.summary: Complete 225 of the 300 missions.

steps.text: Keep clearing missions from any save point until 225 are finished.

achievements.description: Completed 100% of all missions.
achievements.sortReason: Full 300-mission grind; gated by the missable accepted missions.
achievements.summary: Complete all 300 missions.

guide.context: Mission progress does not carry into New Game+, and 54 missions must be accepted before the Chapter 7 point of no return, so finish all 300 on this save file.

steps.text: Before the point of no return at the end of Chapter 7, accept every missable mission chain: 2-1-1, 4-3-1, 1-2-1, 7-1-1, 8-2-1, 6-2-1, 6-4-1, 6-5-1, and 6-6-1.
Build a @mechanic{Buster Sword stance} loadout with @item{Darkness} for groups and @item{Costly Punch} for bosses so most enemies die in one hit.
Clear missions from save points until the mission counter reaches 300.

achievements.description: Unlocked all shops.
achievements.sortReason: Depends on mission-reward shops and the Chapter 9 chest.
achievements.summary: Unlock every shop.

guide.context: Four shops are tied to missable missions and must be triggered before the Chapter 7 point of no return; Research Dept. QMC+ instead comes from a Chapter 9 chest.

steps.text: Open the @loc{Research Dept. QMC+} shop from the chest in the Chapter 9 @loc{Gongaga Outskirts}.
Complete Mission 4-3-6 to unlock @loc{The Happy Turtle}.
Complete Missions 6-2-1, 6-2-3, and 6-2-6 to unlock the Sec.8, Sec.5, and Sec.6 shops.
Complete Mission 9-5-4 to unlock the final online shop.

achievements.description: Received mail from all senders.
achievements.sortReason: Needs the missable mail senders and mission-exclusive senders.
achievements.summary: Receive mail from every sender.

guide.context: One mail per sender is enough, and several senders are missable during the story.

steps.text: Join all 5 fan clubs: Red Leather, Keepers of Honor, and LOVELESS Study Group in Sector 8, The Silver Elite in Sector 6 Slums Park, and the Zack Fan Club in Chapter 7.
In Chapter 5, find the Reporter at @loc{Sector 8 Fountain} and choose to let him leave.
Finish the @loc{Nibelheim} Seven Wonders quest to add Wonder Hunter as a sender.
Complete Mission 6-2-1 for Shop News and the Mission 8-4-1 through 8-5-6 chain for the remaining mission senders.

achievements.description: Collected all Genji equipment.
achievements.sortReason: Genji Armor comes from 100% DMW; the rest are endgame mission rewards.
achievements.summary: Collect all Genji equipment.

guide.context: The Genji Armor is the 100% DMW reward and the only piece that can be lost for good.

steps.text: Reach 100% progress on all DMW Limit Breaks to receive the @item{Genji Armor}.
In Mission 7-6-6, find the @enemy{Magic Pot} and satisfy it with @item{Gil Toss}, @item{Costly Punch}, 99,999 damage, and @item{Octaslash} for the @item{Genji Shield}.
Unlock the Online Shop Shade store by clearing Mission 9-5-4, then buy the @item{Genji Helm} there for 1,000,000 Gil.
Open the treasure chest in Mission 9-6-4 for the @item{Genji Glove}.

achievements.description: Earn the highest evaluation for the Chapter 1 assault on Fort Tamblin.
achievements.sortReason: Fort Tamblin section in Chapter 1.
achievements.summary: Defeat all 16 enemy groups inside Fort Tamblin in Chapter 1.

guide.context: The top-left tracker starts with only 11 of the 16 groups; the other 5 are hidden behind rotating walls and inside wooden towers.

steps.text: Inside the fort, watch the top-left sword icons and defeat every visible enemy group.
Interact with the 3 rotating walls and the 2 wooden towers to reveal and defeat the hidden groups.
If groups remain at the exit, choose "I'll take out all the enemies here first!" and keep fighting until all 16 icons show a green checkmark.
Leave the fort; the achievement appears in the woods cutscene when Lazard hands over the Fire Armlet.

achievements.description: Joined every fan club.
achievements.sortReason: Fan clubs span Chapters 2-7 and gate a mail sender.
achievements.summary: Join all 5 fan clubs.

guide.context: Fan clubs are easy to walk past, and joining them adds mail senders needed for the mail achievement.

steps.text: In Sector 8, join Red Leather and Keepers of Honor at the Fountain and LOVELESS Study Group on LOVELESS Avenue.
In Chapter 5, join The Silver Elite in @loc{Sector 6 Slums Park}; answer Masamune, Super Nova, and His left hand.
In Chapter 6, talk to Cissnei at the @loc{Upper Junon Level 8} elevator, then join the Zack Fan Club at the Shinra Building reception in Chapter 7.

achievements.description: Prevented the Materia Room from being shut down.
achievements.sortReason: Materia Room missions must be accepted in Midgar before the Chapter 7 point of no return.
achievements.summary: Give the Researcher 6 Mako Stones in Chapter 2's Materia Room.

guide.context: The Materia Room is an optional side door that is easy to miss, but the chain stays available until the Chapter 7 point of no return.

steps.text: At the start of Chapter 2, before talking to Tseng, leave the Briefing Room toward the Fountain and go back into the Shinra Building.
Take the elevator to the @loc{SOLDIER Floor}, enter the @loc{MATERIA ROOM} beside a save point, and speak to the Researcher inside to unlock Mission 8-2-1.
Complete the 8-2-1 up to 8-2-6 chain to collect 6 @item{Mako Stones}.
Give all 6 Mako Stones to the Researcher.

achievements.description: Collected all items and arrived at Angeal's house before the Banora airstrike.
achievements.sortReason: Banora Village and the airstrike timer in Chapter 2.
achievements.summary: Collect all 5 Banora items and reach Angeal's house before the airstrike.

guide.context: The items only appear during the escape if Zack interacted with each sparkling point before entering the factory.

steps.text: Interact with all 5 golden sparkling points: 3 in @loc{Banora Village} and 2 on the cliffside path up toward Tseng.
Continue through the factory and slice the 10 rockets.
During the 45-second timer, grab all 5 items from their original spots and enter Angeal's house.

achievements.description: Saved everyone calling for help during the assault on the Shinra Building in Chapter 3.
achievements.sortReason: Shinra Building assault choice in Chapter 3.
achievements.summary: Save all 5 people during the Chapter 3 Shinra Building assault.

guide.context: The elevator offers two routes; the people are only reachable by choosing to get off and look around.

steps.text: When the elevator prompts, choose "Get off and look around".
On the @loc{SOLDIER Floor}, save the 2 people in the hallway and the 1 in the Training Room.
Return to the elevator and answer "Head to the entrance right away"; clear the 2 fights.
In @loc{Sector 8 LOVELESS Avenue}, save the 2 people calling for help.

achievements.description: Defeated all virtual data in the Training Room.
achievements.sortReason: Training Room virtual data fights in Chapter 3.
achievements.summary: Defeat all 4 Virtual Data fights in the Chapter 3 Training Room.

guide.context: The Training Room is open from the start of Chapter 3.

steps.text: From the Chapter 3 starting point, enter the @loc{Training Room} immediately to the left.
Complete all 4 Virtual Data fights; the 4th is the miniboss @enemy{Experiment No. 88}.
steps.note: Attack Experiment No. 88 from the side or behind, since it cannot hit to its sides.

achievements.description: Achieved 100% recovery with the Mako Recovery Unit.
achievements.sortReason: Mako Recovery Unit timing in Chapter 4.
achievements.summary: Stop the Mako Recovery Unit at exactly 5 seconds for 100% recovery.

guide.context: Only the timing of the button press matters, and retries are free.

steps.text: In the Chapter 4 @loc{Fusion Chamber}, interact with the machine left of Hojo.
Press the confirm button exactly 5 seconds after the countdown begins.

achievements.description: Judged by Hojo to be a "SOLDIER member of significant worth" in the Fusion Chamber.
achievements.sortReason: Fusion Chamber quiz in Chapter 4.
achievements.summary: Pass Hojo's Fusion Chamber evaluation in Chapter 4.

steps.text: In the @loc{Fusion Chamber}, cross the middle bridge to the fusion chamber and start the evaluation.
Answer "A SOLDIER operative like Sephiroth", then "State-of-the-art science and technology", then "A person unafraid to challenge Shinra".

achievements.description: Checked all cells on the 67th floor of the Shinra Building.
achievements.sortReason: 67th floor cell section in Chapter 4.
achievements.summary: Open all 6 Experiment cells on the Shinra Building's 67th floor.

guide.context: The section is timed and needs Steal materia plus the keys held by the Experiment enemies.

steps.text: Equip the @item{Steal materia} Bruno gives you while leaving the Slums.
In the @loc{Fusion Chamber}, press the switch next to Hojo to start the timer.
Use @item{Steal} on all 6 @enemy{Experiment} enemies to take their keys.
Open each of the 6 cells and loot the 3 chests inside, then return to Hojo before time runs out.

achievements.description: Caught all the Wutai spies that had infiltrated Midgar.
achievements.sortReason: Wutai spy hunt across Midgar, must finish before Chapter 7's point of no return.
achievements.summary: Catch all 6 Wutai spies hiding in Midgar.

guide.context: The spies appear in a fixed order, and each disguise only breaks after 3 conversations.

steps.text: Agree to help the SOLDIER 2nd Class who waits in @loc{Sector 8 LOVELESS Avenue}, then hunt the spies.
Catch the man outside the LOVELESS theatre, the Shinra Trooper in @loc{Sector 5 Market}, then the employee at the upstairs elevator in the @loc{Shinra Building Entrance}.
Catch the woman outside the @loc{Sector 1 Train Station} entrance, the employee at the rocket in the @loc{Exhibit Room}, and the capped kid at @loc{Sector 6 Slums Park}.
Talk to each spy 3 times until the disguise breaks.
steps.note: Talking to a spy out of order does nothing.

achievements.description: Helped every fan club continue their activities.
achievements.sortReason: Fan club questlines in Chapter 7's final Midgar free roam.
achievements.summary: Help both struggling fan clubs continue their activities in Chapter 7.

guide.context: Both questlines start around @loc{Sector 8 Fountain} and must finish before the Chapter 7 point of no return.

steps.text: At the Fountain, tell the Genesis Fan to merge with a richer club, then talk to the Genesis Fan on @loc{LOVELESS Avenue} and return to the first fan.
At the Fountain, talk to the boy searching for his mother.
Talk to the mother at @loc{Sector 1 Train Station} and choose "mother without honor", then return to where the boy stood.

achievements.description: Construct every flower wagon type in Midgar.
achievements.sortReason: Flower wagon parts come from missions, spies, the squat minigame, and Chapter 7 story.
achievements.summary: Build all 3 flower wagons for Aerith.

guide.context: Wagon parts come from optional Midgar side quests and the squatting minigame, so most are collected before Chapter 7.

steps.text: Collect Craftsman Monthly from Missions 1-2-1 up to 1-2-6, Premium Tires from Missions 7-1-1 up to 7-1-6, Mythril Tools from Missions 2-1-1 up to 2-1-6, Walnut Wood from the 6 Wutai spies, and the four parts from beating the squatting minigame.
Pick up the story parts Used Tools, Old Lumber, Worn Tires, and How to Build a Wagon during Chapter 7.
Build the first wagon, then at the point-of-no-return prompt choose "Wait, I need a little more time!", then return to Aerith to build the second and third wagons.

achievements.description: Learned about all of Nibelheim's Seven Wonders.
achievements.sortReason: Nibelheim Seven Wonders span Chapters 8-9 and gate the Phoenix image.
achievements.summary: Learn about all 7 of Nibelheim's Seven Wonders.

guide.context: The quest starts when Nibelheim is first visited in Chapter 8, and the final Wonder is found early in Chapter 9.

steps.text: When you first reach @loc{Nibelheim}, speak to the boy on the right and report each Wonder you solve.
Solve Wonders 1 through 6 around Nibelheim, Mt. Nibel, and Shinra Manor, reporting each one to the boy.
In early Chapter 9, take the @item{Wall materia} from behind the low fence in the northeast corner of @loc{Nibelheim Outskirts}.

achievements.description: Opened the path to the Cage of Binding.
achievements.sortReason: Depths of Judgement section shortly before the final boss.
achievements.summary: Unseal the Cage of Binding in Chapter 10.

steps.text: In the @loc{Depths of Judgement}, read the LOVELESS Prologue tablet.
Read Act III in @loc{Portal of Severance} to the west and Act II in @loc{Howling Fang} to the east.
Read Act I just outside the @loc{Lake of Oblivion} entrance to the south.
Enter the Lake of Oblivion, interact with the 5 mako springs, and defeat each enemy that spawns to open the path north.

achievements.description: Cut down every incoming shell.
achievements.sortReason: Rocket-slicing minigame in Chapter 2.
achievements.summary: Slice all 10 rockets after the Banora factory in Chapter 2.

guide.context: The rockets must be cut in one unbroken run, so a single miss fails the sequence.

steps.text: Press the slice button when the blue reticle appears on each incoming rocket.
On the 10th rocket, wait for its reticle because it arrives from a different camera angle.

achievements.description: Blended a perfume with the perfect amount of oil.
achievements.sortReason: Perfume minigame in the Chapter 4 market.
achievements.summary: Blend a perfect perfume in the Chapter 4 Slums Market.

guide.context: Drip counts as 1, DripDrip as 2, and Splash! as 10.

steps.text: Once your wallet is back, use the @loc{Shopping Paradise} store in the market.
Count the drops and press confirm when the running total matches the target.
steps.note: Retries cost Gil, but a save point sits next to the store.

achievements.description: Guessed the exact number in the number-guessing game.
achievements.sortReason: Number-guessing minigame in the Chapter 4 market.
achievements.summary: Guess the exact number of passing kids in the Chapter 4 market.

guide.context: Aerith offers 2 or 3 numbers, and paying the boy 50 Gil adds 3 more.

steps.text: Once your wallet is back, find the boy in the market corner at @loc{Sector 5 Slums Market}.
Ask @npc{Aerith} for her guess, then pay the boy 50 Gil for his numbers.
Pick the number that appears in both lists.

achievements.description: Rated to have "godlike speed" in collecting materia.
achievements.sortReason: Timed materia-collection minigame in the Chapter 4 market.
achievements.summary: Collect all 20 materia in under 14 seconds in the Chapter 4 market.

guide.context: The clock only stops once you speak to the shopkeeper again, and the run can be repeated freely.

steps.text: Once your wallet is back, speak to the older shopkeeper at the @loc{Item World} store.
Sprint and mash the pickup button to grab all 20 @item{materia} before the timer passes 14 seconds.
Talk to the shopkeeper after the last pickup to end the run.

achievements.description: Achieved victory against the SOLDIER 2nd Class in the physical fitness test.
achievements.sortReason: Squatting minigame in the Chapter 5 Training Room.
achievements.summary: Beat all 4 opponents in the Chapter 5 squatting minigame.

guide.context: The press timing changes with each opponent's speed.

steps.text: In the Chapter 5 @loc{Training Room}, speak to the man there to begin the squatting contest.
Press with each opponent: hands and feet together at Speed 1, hands and sword together at Speed 2, arms swung farthest back at Speed 3, and the instant he ducks at Speed 4.

achievements.description: Infiltrated the mako excavation facility without being discovered once.
achievements.sortReason: Modeo Ravine stealth section in Chapter 5.
achievements.summary: Reach the exit of the Chapter 5 mako excavation facility without being spotted.

guide.context: Being seen fails the run, but reloading a manual save returns you to the entrance.

steps.text: Make a manual save at the save point before the @loc{Modeo Ravine} facility.
Sneak past the patrolling guards, crouching in the blue zones to hide while they pass.
Leave through the exit with no guard having detected Zack.

achievements.description: Defeated all enemies in Defense of the Junon Perimeter.
achievements.sortReason: Defense of the Junon Perimeter minigame in Chapter 6.
achievements.summary: Stop all 30 enemies in the Chapter 6 Defense of the Junon Perimeter.

guide.context: Any enemy that reaches the purple outline at the road's far end ends the attempt.

steps.text: During the Junon perimeter minigame, hold position near the purple goal line.
Run into every enemy heading for the goal and defeat all 30.

achievements.description: Did not allow a single gun bull head to escape while sniping.
achievements.sortReason: Nibelheim sniper section in Chapter 9.
achievements.summary: Kill every gun bull head at all 8 sniping spots in Chapter 9.

guide.context: The sniping section has no checkpoints, and alerted robots flee if left too long.

steps.text: At each spot, kill the robots before they escape; a headshot one-shots the regular ones.
After the 3rd spot, farm the respawning robots to fully upgrade the sniper rifle before continuing.

At spot 4 kill the moving robots right, then left, then middle. At spot 5 take the right split and shoot the barrel. At spot 6 defeat the @enemy{BIGGS} and @enemy{WEDGE} bosses on the left road. At spot 7 shoot the shields. At spot 8 shoot the barrel and finish the rest.

achievements.description: Collected ten chests coming down the waterfall in the hills of Gongaga.
achievements.sortReason: Gongaga waterfall minigame in Chapter 9; also rewards Goblin Punch.
achievements.summary: Collect all 10 chests in the Chapter 9 Gongaga waterfall minigame.

guide.context: The minigame only appears after winning at least 7 battles in the Gongaga Hills, and it can be retried.

steps.text: In the @loc{Gongaga Hills}, after the Genesis cutscene, win at least 7 battles.
Approach the area exit to trigger the minigame and choose to take part.
Grab every chest as it floats down while dodging the enemies that paralyze Zack; collect all 10 to also earn the @item{Goblin Punch} materia.

achievements.description: Reach high affection with Aerith during Chapter 4.
achievements.sortReason: Aerith affection choices in the Chapter 4 market.
achievements.summary: Raise Aerith's affection so Bruno calls you a good couple in Chapter 4.

guide.context: The scene plays at the end of Sector 5, and Aerith's affection decides whether Bruno's line is the good-couple one.

steps.text: In the @loc{Sector 5 Slums Market}, interact with all 3 shops while looking for Bruno, wait 10 times with the girl, and give the boy 5 potions.
Blend 3 perfect perfumes at @loc{Shopping Paradise} and post a fast time in the @loc{Item World} materia collection.
Continue to the end of @loc{Sector 5} and listen for Bruno's "good couple" line.

achievements.description: Defeat the hidden superboss of the endgame mission line.
achievements.sortReason: Hardest superboss, fought during the mission grind.
achievements.summary: Defeat Minerva in Mission 9-6-6.

guide.context: Minerva is the game's hardest boss and is fought on the way to 100% mission completion.

steps.text: Build a loadout with high VIT and SPR, @item{Costly Punch}, and @item{Mug}.
From a save point, launch the Reigning Deity mission (9-6-6).
Defeat @enemy{Minerva}.
steps.note: Heal to full while she charges Judgement Arrow, which strips Phoenix Down revival.

achievements.description: Cleared the game in Hard Mode.
achievements.sortReason: Switch to Hard and defeat the final boss after cleanup.
achievements.summary: Clear the game in Hard mode.

guide.context: Only the final boss has to be fought on Hard, and the difficulty can be changed at any time.

steps.text: Before the final boss, open the menu and set @mechanic{Difficulty} to Hard under Gameplay Settings.
Defeat the final boss with Hard selected.
